The number-average molecular weight M_n is calculated as the sum of the products of each molar mass and its count divided by the total count.
The sample has counts of 96, 131, 153, and 146 for molar masses 56526, 92809, 115856, and 126029 g/mol, respectively.
The total count is 526.
The sum of mass-count products is 53,710,677 g/mol·count.
M_n is 53,710,677 divided by 526, which equals approximately 102,112 g/mol.
